record_note: Every Ley and Constitution SINALEVI lists (31 norms, 1439 versions), from each norm's first SINALEVI version; SINALEVI began keeping versions about 2001, so most changes before then are folded into one labelled consolidated version. Retrieved 2026-10-28.

dates.commit: in-force (Fecha de vigencia desde of the norm that caused the version)

scope.when_absent: no scope note found; not a statement that the change reaches every case (not extracted for Costa Rica)

default_reach.meaning: no law has retroactive effect to the prejudice of any person or of acquired rights or consolidated legal situations
default_reach.authority: Constitucion Politica de la Republica de Costa Rica, articulo 34; Codigo Civil, articulo 9 (laws take effect on the date they designate, otherwise ten days after publication)
